cards.title: Severe error rate spike during hour 14
cards.detail: Hour 14 recorded 1,460 errors out of 9,225 requests (15.8% error rate), compared to a baseline of 31 errors per hour. This hour accounts for 1,460 of the 2,169 total errors recorded across the week.

cards.title: Caller-01 drives half of all traffic and spend
cards.detail: Caller-01 generated 105,832 requests (51.6% of overall volume) and $1,643.86 in spend (49.0% of total spend).

cards.title: Caller-07 shows disproportionately high cost per request
cards.detail: Caller-07 incurred $174.12 in spend across 1,180 requests, averaging $0.148 per request compared to the overall average of $0.016 per request.

cards.title: Low cache hit rates across multiple high-volume callers
cards.detail: Several callers have cache hit rates below 10%, including caller-03 (7.7% over 7,767 requests), caller-13 (8.9% over 7,351 requests), and caller-17 (6.2% over 7,469 requests).

cards.title: Model-alpha experiences highest p95 latency
cards.detail: Model-alpha recorded a p95 latency of 2,454 ms across 86,080 requests, compared to 1,310 ms for model-gamma across 36,892 requests.
